meaning: Shorted pressure switch, 1st stage: PS1 is closed when it should be open.
causes: Pressure switch wiring or tube routing incorrect
PS1 not oriented correctly for the application
diySteps: Technician: verify pressure switch wiring, tube routing and orientation
Technician: replace pressure switch, or verify wiring and replace IFC
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: pressure switch diagnosis requires a meter.
